en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Abdullah Bukeyr, from some of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that he heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and two other men brought him<sup>asws</sup> out until when they came out from Al-Kufa. They left it (Al-Kufa) upon their right, then they took (the way) of Al-Jabban until they passed with him<sup>asws</sup> to Al-Ghary, so they buried him<sup>asws</sup>, and evened out his<sup>asws</sup> grave, and they left’.
